title: Keynote 3D NOC is the first concrete read-side consumer
summary: Wire3D/Keynote joins Instrumentation observations to separately authoritative deployment geography and renders current state, history, freshness, operational relationships, events and explicit correlation without becoming service or topology authority.

verified_consumer.status: last package inspected for this sphere

rules: Declared/static topology and observed operational relationships are independent graph layers.
Unknown relationship endpoints remain semantic evidence; Wire3D must not invent geometry.
Expected but unobserved services remain visible as incomplete/unobserved rather than disappearing.
HEALTHY+STALE means the last source health was healthy but observation freshness has expired.
Operational correlation groups are evidence groups, not incidents created by the NOC.
Context references may associate an event with an affected service/site without changing the event subject.
